description: This file defines a class ClientAddressableTestGrain that implements the IClientAddressableTestGrain interface. It contains methods for testing and stress simulations that interact with a target object implementing IClientAddressableTestClientObject, and uses Xunit assertions.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class implementing IClientAddressableTestGrain, designed for stress testing and message handling.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target object for subsequent test method calls.

methods.name: HappyPath
methods.description: Delegates a message to the target's OnHappyPath method.

methods.name: SadPath
methods.description: Delegates a message to the target's OnSadPath method.

methods.name: MicroSerialStressTest
methods.description: Performs a serial stress test by calling target.OnSerialStress repeatedly and asserting expected results.

methods.name: MicroParallelStressTest
methods.description: Performs a parallel stress test by launching multiple target.OnParallelStress calls concurrently and asserting results.
